sources.title: How does the government budget process work? - USAFacts
sources.excerpt: Congress last passed a full budget in 1997.

sources.title: Congress has long struggled to pass spending bills on time
sources.excerpt: measures on time only four times in nearly five decades.

reasoning: Data from the Pew Research Center and USAFacts confirms that Congress has not passed all of its required individual appropriations bills on time (prior to the October 1 start of the fiscal year) since fiscal year 1997 (passed in late 1996). Since then, the federal government has been funded through temporary continuing resolutions or late-passed omnibus spending packages.
